articles.summary: Trestle Co-Founder and CSO, Alice Chen, Ph.D., provides insight on the fields of kidney stem cell biology and regenerative medicine, and how Trestle is advancing bioengineered kidney tissues for patients with kidney failure. The post Nature Outlook Highlights Research in the Fight Against Chronic Kidney Disease first appeared on Trestle Biotherapeutics .
